Make A status unknown, re-auth B, refuse overlapping A, cancel B without dropping its allocated row
Restart the host and native roster, re-auth B at its original store, check A remains ready

steps.result: PASS: host-only exact managed sign-in prerequisite; no engine routing, principal deduplication, keyring or live-account claim

verdicts.seen: I read all 7 entries. Claude: A and B signed in at distinct stores, B login never selected A ("B login/status never selected A"); overlapping re-auth refused busy; cancelling B preserved its id, folder and native data; after restart, re-auth kept the same B binding. Codex: A and B signed in directly at distinct final stores, with B never selecting A. The outcome's sign-in and re-auth of an exact row without sibling selection is shown. The restart and cancel claim is shown for Claude only, which is what the outcome names. The 'installed target not probed' note and the PASS line's exclusions (no keyring or live-account claim) limit scope but do not contradict the outcome. The outcome names one part, so parts is empty.
